purpose: Development selection record; reserved validation seeds remain unused. Development estimates are selection-biased and do not establish tournament win probability.
uncertainty: Shared-card cluster normal intervals, conditional 50-deal moving block bootstrap, and whole-seed Student-t intervals; persistent whole-half adaptation and only two/four development seeds limit precision.
timing_scope: Direct calls exclude HTTP/time-bank enforcement. Host contention and earlier frozen-network loader performance differences make deployment timing a separate official-container check.

selection_evidence.calmer_split: HALF raise margin 0.025; POT margin 0.046244728490194446; preflop threshold 0.543415645869242; 192 samples, no refinement, draw/showdown/check experiments off, river mix 0.
selection_evidence.neural_anchor: Both on/off variants beat the released incumbent across four independent development seeds in extended 500-deal duplicate matches. Broad external-pool improvement and the incremental contribution of the neural anchor are unproven.
selection_evidence.rejected_activations: Broad development tests did not support default NN opponent-range ranks, extra particles/refinement, sensible checks, showdown density learning, or uniform/range-conditioned toy river CFR. Lower preflop threshold and unified lower POT margins increase aggression and did not satisfy the calmer-selection preference.
selection_evidence.future_cap: Enabled enforceable future-loss cap after matched True/False screen produced exactly identical paired outcomes on all 16 cases (4 profiles x 4 seeds x 250 duplicate deals). This is a mathematical risk-bound correction, not a measured field win-rate gain.
